gameDescriptionHtml:
Have you ever imagined stepping through a mirror to encounter your “Reflection”?

To rescue her twin sister, Lia, who is trapped within the mirrors, a young girl named Ail embarks on a perilous adventure across mirrored dimensions. Her sole ability is to phase through mirror surfaces and traverse the mirrored space—a realm where every reflection is tangible. Here, paths within the mirrors can be trodden upon, mechanics in the mirror can be triggered, and the entire mirrored world is fully interactive. By moving and rotating mirrors, you will manipulate your surroundings and use your imagination to forge new paths, solving intricate puzzles where reality and illusion intertwine as you journey toward the end.

Game Features

  • Innovative Mirror Mechanics – Break the boundaries between reality and illusion. The reflection is no longer a simple projection but a tangible space that you can explore and interact with. Every passage through the mirror provides a brand-new perspective for puzzle-solving.
  • Immersive Aesthetic Exploration – Traverse seven distinct scenes inspired by traditional Chinese art. From ink-wash bamboo forests to glazed mirror palaces, you can unlock side quests, secret rooms, and hidden surprises within this Oriental artistic landscape.
  • Hardcore Puzzle Challenges – Conquer over 100 meticulously designed puzzles and unlock seemingly impossible challenges within hidden areas. Collect Mirror Fragments to awaken the long-lost memories of the bond between Ail and Lia.
  • Crafted Original Soundtrack – Composer Mark Benis brings together top-tier musicians who have performed for renowned titles such as Elden Ring, Street Fighter V, and Final Fantasy XV: Assassin’s Festival. Centered on the core concept of “Reflection,” the soundtrack fuses traditional Chinese instruments like the Erhu, Dizi, and Xiao with the Western violin to create an “East-meets-West mirrored sonic domain.” The main theme weaves through the score using techniques such as note inversion, melody reversal, and reverse audio. These techniques serve as a musical metaphor for the mirror reflecting the myriad forms of the world and deeply immerse you in the emotional bond between Ail and Lia.
  • Ultimate Puzzle Mastery – Experience diverse types of spatial puzzles centered entirely around mirrors. The game innovatively integrates various reflection-based mechanics including water reflections, mirror recursion, and even mirror-puzzle boss battles. This design creates an exceptionally rich experience in both visuals and gameplay.
  • Interwoven Narrative – The story features three interwoven threads. The main thread follows your adventure in the mirror world. The subtle thread consists of real-world memories triggered after breaking each Magic Mirror. A hidden thread follows the twin sister and unlocks by collecting Mirror Fragments in challenging stages. Fragmented storytelling through soul shards scattered across in-game scenes provides gameplay hints while enriching the world with poetic philosophy. Both the theme song and narrative stem from the creators’ real-life experiences. They explore how to reconcile with the world and oneself after the loss of a loved one.
